ideas.dish: Pumpkin and tomato groundnut stew with rice
method: Sweat onions, ginger and garlic in oil.
Add diced pumpkin, tomatoes and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter until creamy; season with chili.
Serve over basmati rice.
ideas.batchTip: Cook the base in tilting kettles a day ahead; it thickens and tastes better reheated.

ideas.dish: Tomato bulgur pilaf with roasted pumpkin
method: Roast pumpkin cubes on trays at 200 °C.
Fry onions with pepper paste and tomatoes.
Add bulgur and hot stock, cover and rest 15 minutes.
Fold in pumpkin and parsley.
ideas.batchTip: Bulgur only needs resting, not boiling, so it frees up stove space at peak time.
ideas.replaces: Potato and vegetable pan with pumpkin falafel and herb quark

extra: sour cream (vegan cream on the side)
method: Grate beetroot and stew it with tomato and a squeeze of lemon.
Simmer potatoes and cabbage in stock.
Combine, season, finish with dill.
Serve with a spoon of sour cream.
ideas.batchTip: Use today's beetroot soup base to save prep; add the cabbage and potatoes to make it a meal.

ideas.dish: Garlic pak choi and portobello over rice
method: Slice portobello and sear hard in batches.
Wok-toss pak choi with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and a little sesame oil.
Serve over rice.
ideas.batchTip: Sear mushrooms in the combi oven at high heat instead of the wok to cook 50 portions at once.

method: Poach chicken and shred it.
Blend tomatoes with chipotle; cook down with onions.
Mix in the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on rice with black beans.
ideas.batchTip: Reuse the chicken from the Thai curry prep; the sauce holds well in bain-maries.
